status: prospective primary proposed for review (amended after development inspection, before any confirmation; Codex R1 decision)
comparator_definition: compatible-set majority: predict 1 iff #{M in V(D): q(M)} > |V(D)|/2, computed with exact integer counts (versionspace.exact_posterior)
world_score: mean over the world's 16 intervention queries of correct(a) - correct(b)
empty_version_space_rule: missing predictions score 0 for both methods (realizable worlds cannot produce an empty V(D)); complete-case sensitivity reported
interval: stratified paired cluster bootstrap over worlds, percentile, two-sided 95%
question: superiority (two-sided); magnitude reported against the 0.05 substantive reference; no equivalence claim
terminal_rule: every planned world must have a terminal ok result; unresolved whole-world failures make the primary incomplete (bounded missing-outcome sensitivity reported, no planned-N claim)

historical_secondary.note: expected accuracy of a uniformly random compatible model; registered v1 primary, retained as secondary

required_null.sampling: IID uniform over the complete class H(n=7,k<=3) per node; no rejection of development overlaps (audited only)
